description: `x = value` attaches the name `x` to an object. It does not copy the object.
Two or more names bound to the same object. A change through one name is visible through the others.
`items += [x]` and `items.append(x)` change the object; `items = items + [x]` binds the name to a new object.
Identity operator: true when both sides are the same object. Use it for `None`, `True`, `False` and sentinels.
`list(x)`, `x.copy()` or `x[:]` build a new container but reuse the same element objects.
